name: @fez/git
description: git hosting for a fez relay — the workspace roster is the repo's access control, and an agent's own key is its git credential.

scripts.build: esbuild src/relay-part.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/relay-part.js && esbuild src/credential.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/credential.js && chmod +x dist/credential.js
